DavjJ_ioxNq.traduccion: The law of attraction is explained easily and easily. You attract what you are, and who are you? You are the set of your dominant thoughts, of your radical beliefs and of your life experiences. Let's make an example right away. Let me introduce you to Pinco and Pallino. Pinco had a bad experience in the course of his life. Society made him believe that he must make many sacrifices to be happy, that he must give up many things to be able to get what he wants, that luck does not exist and that success is for few people. So he started to believe that this is the only reality existing, the only possible for him. Pinco starts to attract experiences that confirm his deep beliefs. Pallino had the same bad experiences as Pinco, but at a certain point he opened his eyes and noticed that in reality, in life you can also be happy, you can do a job that you love, you can achieve your goals, you can feel serenity and love. So Pallino decided to make a change, he started to believe instead that he is a lucky person, that he can find many beautiful things, he can feel paid, he can be happy in his life. He started to deeply convince himself that his life could be very beautiful. And just like Pinco, Pallino started to attract experiences that confirm his new reality. So both Pinco and Pallino know how to attract in the right way, both use the law of attraction in the right way. The difference, however, lies in what each of them believes.

Dd9StoRotBm.traduccion: You don't get what you want just because you want it. When you say or think I want this thing with desperation, your mind is concentrating all the attention on the fact that it doesn't have it. And you can't have what you want, you can only have what you are. Our dear Pinco spends his days chasing his goals. For example, he says I want more money, I want someone who loves me, I want a better job. But the more he rushes with anxiety what he wants, the more that desire moves away from him. It's exactly like chasing a cat. If you run after him with the urge to catch him, he runs away. If instead you sit in serenity and tranquility, it's him who will come to you sooner or later. Pinco, as always, understood the trick. It doesn't start with the desperate desire. Pinco begins to behave, to feel as if he had already paid. As if he had already obtained what he wanted. So he doesn't hope, he doesn't run away, he doesn't run away. He embodies the feeling of having everything. So if you run away with desperation, with anxiety, with attachment to what you want, the result goes away. If you become the person who already owns it, at the level of imagination and sensations, the result comes close to you. And you will see that sooner or later it will manifest itself.
